summary: Cross-platform visualization and management tool for OpenAI Codex featuring provider/API switching, session synchronization, prompt injection, and skills/MCP management.
usecases: Centralized management of multiple LLM providers and APIs in a single interface
Synchronize sessions across different development environments for collaboration
Inject custom prompts and manage skills within the application
ideas: Add multi-language support to expand usability across global teams
Implement real-time collaboration features for shared codex instances
Provide export functionality for model configurations and training data
